caption: The video showcases a single-story house at night, blanketed in Christmas lights: icicle strands trace the roofline, star outlines and Santa figures sit on top, the garage glows pink, and the yard holds a wire reindeer, candy-cane poles and gingerbread houses. Throughout the clip the camera eases back in a widening, the roofline stars shifting toward center while the green-lit tree at the left and the waving snowman at the right edge stay in view. Meanwhile the display animates continuously, the wheel light shifting pattern and the central props flickering between hues. These changes run independently of the camera shift, the reindeer outline holding steady as the wheel light flips color, while the icicle twinkle persists throughout without either motion reaching a finished state.
